'Sarathi has a 2x lower token throughput compared to vLLM as measured by tail TBT-based metric'; chart reads give 0.65/0.34 = 1.9. Workload: Arxiv-Summarization requests, rope-scaling for >8192 tokens; Sarathi-Serve = vLLM with chunked prefill. Fig 6b: at capacity vLLM has higher deadline miss rate at lower percentiles.

Di = Dp + i*Dd; Dp prefill target (function of prompt length), Dd decode (TBT) deadline; deadline miss when actual generation time of token i exceeds Di; after a miss at token s deadlines are reset from completion of that token; early tokens carry forward slack (Fig 4, Algorithm 1)
Three decode targets: strict 25 ms (interactive chat), medium 50 ms, relaxed 100 ms

rows.loc: §3.1 p.5 and Fig 3 caption p.4; §4.2 p.7
rows.note: SLO used: 99% of requests have fluidity-index >= 0.9 (i.e., <10% deadline miss) ; fluid token generation rate = inverse of minimum Dd meeting it
Scheduling slack SD is added to the prefill deadline (Dp = predict_prefill_time(P) + SD) and is 'a small scheduling slack ... determined empirically'; its numeric value is not printed in the paper
Dp is fitted from profiling vLLM prefill time vs input length on 10 requests (tunable) in isolation; no fixed numeric Dp

extraction.method: Text via pdftotext; Figures 3b and 6a viewed as rendered 500-dpi crops and bar heights read against gridlines; Algorithm 1 and §4.1 text read.

cross_check.max_disagreement: Fig 3b chart reads: vLLM tail-TBT throughput 1.4 vs 1.5, fluid rate 3.3 vs 3.5 tok/s (<=7 %); Fig 6a capacities 0.34 vs 0.35, 1.16 vs 1.17 QPS (<=3 %)
cross_check.resolved: within stated chart-read uncertainty; use printed text where available (0.6 QPS fluidity both; '3x' tail-TBT; '2x lower' P99-TBT capacity); Fig 3 model/hardware not stated by paper

caveats: No numeric TPOT (ms) or P99 TBT (ms) values are printed for the vLLM vs Sarathi-Serve pair; only the 1 s vLLM tail TBT and chart-read throughputs (inverse metrics).
Model/hardware for Fig 3 not stated in the text; Fig 6 is Llama3-8B on H100, Arxiv-Summarization.
Fig 3b: paper text says 3x, chart reads give ~3.9x for tail-TBT throughput; chart ratio uncertain.
